hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Reset the count "turnInCurrState".
Call arg.

Count up "turnInCurrState".
Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form "4" on the enemy.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of the enemy and the enemy → get-current-param-id is not paramIdBySuffixNo, then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
Otherwise, if part 3 of the group of the enemy is dead and the enemy → get-current-param-id is not paramIdBySuffixNo, then
  The enemy changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
Otherwise
  If condition flag v is up this frame and the enemy has the NULL_PHYSICAL status, then the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_07"}], [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: the NULL_PHYSICAL status}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  If condition flag v2 is up this frame, then the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_06"}], [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the NULL_PHYSICAL status}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  If the count "turnInCurrState" is more than 1 and not the register's 'anyAbilityDone', then
    Choose state 13 next.
    Set the register's 'anyAbilityDone' to true and stop.
  Otherwise
    If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
    Stop.
